## Class Schedule

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

# === EDIT THESE PARAMETERS ===

start_date   <- as.Date("2026-08-24")
end_date     <- as.Date("2026-12-18")
meeting_days <- c("Thursday")   # e.g., c("Monday", "Wednesday", "Friday")

# Holidays / non-instructional days that fall on a meeting day.
# Key = ISO date string, value = label shown in the Topic column.
holidays <- c(
  "2026-11-26" = "HOLIDAY: Thanksgiving"
)

# Topic / Prep / Turn-in for each CLASS meeting in order.
# Do NOT include holiday rows here — they are inserted automatically.
# Add or remove rows to match the number of class meetings.
class_content <- data.frame(
  topic   = c("Course intro",          "TBD", "TBD", "TBD",
              "TBD",                   "TBD", "TBD", "TBD",
              "TBD",                   "TBD", "TBD", "TBD",
              "TBD",                   "TBD", "TBD", "TBD"),
  prep    = rep("", 16),
  turn_in = rep("", 16),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# === GENERATED SCHEDULE — typically no need to edit below ===

day_nums <- match(meeting_days,
                  c("Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday",
                    "Thursday","Friday","Saturday")) - 1
all_dates     <- seq(start_date, end_date, by = "day")
meeting_dates <- all_dates[as.POSIXlt(all_dates)$wday %in% day_nums]

ref_monday <- meeting_dates[1] -
              (as.integer(format(meeting_dates[1], "%u")) - 1)
weeks <- as.integer(floor(as.numeric(meeting_dates - ref_monday) / 7) + 1)

is_holiday <- as.character(meeting_dates) %in% names(holidays)
n <- length(meeting_dates)
topics  <- character(n)
preps   <- character(n)
turnins <- character(n)

topics[is_holiday] <- holidays[as.character(meeting_dates[is_holiday])]

class_idx <- which(!is_holiday)
n_class   <- length(class_idx)
if (nrow(class_content) < n_class) {
  pad <- n_class - nrow(class_content)
  class_content <- rbind(
    class_content,
    data.frame(topic = rep("TBD", pad), prep = rep("", pad),
               turn_in = rep("", pad), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
}
topics[class_idx]  <- class_content$topic[seq_len(n_class)]
preps[class_idx]   <- class_content$prep[seq_len(n_class)]
turnins[class_idx] <- class_content$turn_in[seq_len(n_class)]

schedule <- data.frame(
  Week        = weeks,
  Date        = format(meeting_dates, "%a, %b %d, %Y"),
  Topic       = topics,
  Prep        = preps,
  `Turn in`   = turnins,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(schedule)
```
